summary.intent: Close the single verification gap in Phase 20 (vault migration) by planning and executing removal of dead migration code, then executing the resulting gap-closure plans.
summary.outcome: Two gap-closure plans were created (Wave 1: API cleanup, Wave 2: client cleanup), verified, and Wave 1 was fully executed. Wave 2 execution was in progress at transcript end.

repo: Phase 20 is 'vault-migration' — v2 blob on IPFS is now canonical; no non-migrated users remain, making DB-stored crypto columns and the migrate endpoint dead code.
Vault entity previously stored encrypted_root_folder_key, encrypted_root_ipns_private_key, and migrated_at columns — all removed as part of zero-knowledge server simplification.
API client is regenerated from the server types, so downstream clients (web, desktop) must be updated after server DTO changes.
Web login had a PATH B (DB decrypt + lazy migration fallback) that needed removal; PATH A also had a DB fallback to strip.
Desktop Rust code had an InitVaultRequest with crypto fields and a non-migrated branch in fetch_and_decrypt_vault — both dead after migration completion.
New user vault init on web was not publishing a v2 blob to IPFS at creation time — this was identified as a gap to fix alongside cleanup.
workflow: Gap closure plans are committed by the planner agent itself — orchestrator should check for existing commits before attempting a redundant commit.
Pre-wave dependency checks based on key-links in PLAN.md frontmatter; if links are only in the plan body they are not checked automatically.
gsd-tools phase-plan-index correctly filters completed plans (has_summary: true) so re-running execute-phase safely resumes from the first incomplete plan.

friction: Orchestrator attempted a redundant commit after plans were already committed by the planner agent (bd236c59a), requiring extra bash commands to detect the duplicate.
open_items: Wave 2 (20-06: client dead migration code removal) was spawned but not confirmed complete in the transcript — needs spot-check and verification.
Phase-level verification (gsd-verifier creating VERIFICATION.md) and ROADMAP.md/STATE.md completion update not yet run — depends on Wave 2 finishing successfully.
